title: Heritage Sweet And Innocent Collection Kristy D-91 Handcrafted Porcelain Doll
categoryName: Dolls & Bears:Dolls, Clothing & Accessories:Dolls & Doll Playsets
descriptionText: The Heritage Sweet And Innocent Collection Kristy D-91 is a handcrafted porcelain doll. This doll is part of a set that includes other dolls, made from high-quality porcelain material. This particular doll, named Kristy D-91, is a beautiful addition to any doll collection, exuding a sweet and innocent charm.
